svg.title: ARQ protocol comparison
svg.text: Reliable delivery over an unreliable channel
Blue: data · purple: retransmission · green dashed: ACK · red ×: lost · orange: timeout · cyan: buffered
Time runs downward. Panels share one time scale. Hover arrows and markers for exact event details.
